title: Zoning text change for 862-868 Kent Avenue, Brooklyn
summary: This resolution approves a zoning text amendment establishing a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area for a site at 862-868 Kent Avenue and 123-125 Taaffe Place in Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn. It works together with a related zoning map amendment to facilitate two new residential buildings with 74 total units, including 19 permanently income-restricted units. The City Council approved the measure on September 24, 2026.
